create.name: Tasha Judson
create.bio:
Tasha Judson came to hatha yoga as a teenager in Pittsburgh and studied East Asian religion and Buddhism at university, followed by a five-month stay in a Tibetan Buddhist programme and a journey to India, where she received an initiation from the Dalai Lama. For more than ten years she sat a ten-day Buddhist retreat every year. She trained as a yoga teacher in the Iyengar and Anusara methods around the turn of the millennium, gained Anusara certification in 2006, and left a nine-year career as a school social studies teacher to teach yoga full time from 2003.

Her classes join close attention to alignment with breath-led movement and careful sequencing, and she presents Anusara as a doorway into the non-dual Tantric philosophy that sits behind it. Since 2016 she has been an authorised teacher of Neelakantha Meditation in Blue Throat Yoga, the school founded by Paul Muller-Ortega, which she teaches one to one and in small groups. She runs her own studio in Williamstown, Massachusetts, with in-person and livestreamed classes, teaches a yearly Winter Study course at Williams College, has taken groups to India, and leads weekends at Kripalu.

courses.title: The Body as Gateway: Exploring the Tantra of Anusara Yoga
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu co-led with fellow Anusara teacher Sara Davidson Flanders. Asana practice is paired with the non-dual Tantric philosophy behind Anusara, along with mantra, breathwork and contemplation, and it is open to students new to either.

courses.title: Learning Neelakantha Meditation
courses.description: Personal instruction in the Neelakantha Meditation practice of Blue Throat Yoga, given over three sessions of about two hours within one week, individually or in a small group. Ongoing support follows through group sittings, conversations with her and the school's online teachings.

courses.title: Tasha Yoga studio and livestream classes
courses.description: Weekly alignment-based yoga classes at her Williamstown studio, from basics and chair yoga to open-level and more advanced sessions, many of them also streamed live. Passes are bought through the studio's booking page.
